en-US.name: Last 30 Days
en-US.summary: Research what people actually say about any topic in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN and more. Requires Python and the selected source tools; paid APIs, accounts and optional browser sessions need separate setup and authorization.

zh-CN.name: 近 30 天研究
zh-CN.summary: 调研任意话题近 30 天的真实讨论，聚合 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket、GitHub 等来源的热帖与观点。需 Python 与所选信源工具；付费 API、账号和可选浏览器会话须自行配置并授权。

requirements.value: Python 3.12+ (Node.js for the bundled X search client) and the third-party source CLIs required by the selected research channels. The runtime check may provision a uv-managed Python 3.12 when uv is present, and setup may install yt-dlp plus the Digg, arXiv and Techmeme CLIs via npx; the operator authorizes these installations separately. DesireCore does not install, license, pay for or operate these tools.

Optional lanes use separately installed CLIs: the Bright Data CLI 0.4+ for Amazon product and review data, and a stable grok CLI 1.0.46+ for the grok X lane. Each new grok build runs X research only after passing a local, offline tool-boundary audit; a failed or incomplete audit stops the grok lane instead of running an unaudited build.

Optional X/platform tokens, paid API services (e.g. ScrapeCreators credits for TikTok/Instagram, Reddit and YouTube backfill and transcripts; Bright Data credits for Amazon; xAI, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Perplexity, Brave) and browser-cookie access require the operator's own credentials, entitlements and explicit consent. Declining browser access must leave a cookie-free research path. Any remote API endpoint is operator-configured; report missing or failed sources honestly.

Writes outside the workspace: setup state, consent markers, the report cache, grok build-audit verdicts and saved keys under ~/.config/last30days (keys in .env, owner-only), and research briefs, the SQLite store and topic queue under ~/Documents/Last30Days by default; an empty LAST30DAYS_MEMORY_DIR disables saves. The operator authorizes these local writes.

Research calls public and operator-configured third-party services (e.g. Reddit and the Arctic Shift archive, Hacker News, Polymarket, dev.to, YouTube via yt-dlp, ScrapeCreators, Bright Data, X API or xAI); --official-site also reads the topic's homepage. Publishing to the hosted ht-ml.app service needs explicit opt-in and is public unless password-protected. DesireCore does not operate or pay for these services; report a source as unavailable rather than inventing results.
